units.source_text: 我醉醺醺地彳亍在銀座的小巷，小聲反覆哼唱著：「這裡離故鄉幾百裡，這裡離故鄉幾百裡。」

en.t: Drunk, I wandered through the lanes of Ginza, softly humming over and over, "Here I am hundreds of miles from home, here I am hundreds of miles from home."

units.source_text: 邊走邊用鞋尖踢散路上的積雪，突然，我嘔吐不止。

en.t: As I walked, kicking apart the snow piled on the road with the toes of my shoes, I suddenly began vomiting uncontrollably.
It was the first time I had ever coughed up blood.

units.source_text: 雪地變成了一面偌大的太陽旗。

en.t: The snowy ground turned into a huge Japanese sun flag.

units.source_text: 我在地上蹲了許久，然後用雙手捧起沒有弄髒的雪，邊洗臉邊哭。

en.t: I crouched on the ground for a long time, then scooped up clean snow in both hands and cried as I washed my face.

units.source_text: 一個小女孩憂傷的歌聲宛如幻覺，隱隱約約地從遠處傳來。

en.t: The sorrowful singing of a little girl came faintly from far away, like a hallucination.

units.source_text: 不幸，這個世界上有許許多多的不幸之人，不，即便說所有人都是不幸之人，也不為過。

en.t: Misfortune: there are countless unfortunate people in this world; no, it would not be too much to say that everyone is unfortunate.
